identityAssessment.finding: The imported feature surrounds Rabinal and nearby Baja Verapaz, approximately 90.77 to 90.13 degrees west and 14.93 to 15.28 degrees north. The cultural subject is Maya Achi. Rabinal’s Chuitinamit is not confused with the Tz’utujil site of the same name near Lake Atitlán. Exact 1492 boundaries remain unverified.

scopeNotes: The regional archaeological period is approximate and is not a founding date for the Achi people.
Álvarez’s older field observations are not dated by the university file’s 2025 upload directory.
A museum catalogue using a broader K’iche’ label was not used to assert an individual Achi maker.
The drama is interpreted as performance and cultural memory, not as direct proof of a particular border or event date.
